caption:
Most service businesses never answer a new lead within the first hour.

The leads are scattered across texts, missed calls, and DMs, with no single place to see who's still waiting.

Black Arrow OS fixes that.

Open it once a day and every lead sits in one list, so you know in two minutes who needs a reply before you touch anything else.

No signup. No card. Just a clearer view of your pipeline.

DM TOOLS

#ServiceBusiness #SmallBusinessGrowth #LeadFollowUp #FreeCRM #ContractorMarketing
rationale: Single-offer promo images convert fastest as lead magnets, and Black Arrow OS gets a fresh 'morning lead check' habit angle distinct from its prior lost-lead framing.
